lines.speaker: narrator
lines.note: Also the kind line after a name that has no clip (Moving Day, R55).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Please turn the iPad on its side.
lines.note: The shell, when the iPad is held upright (platform A9).

lines.speaker: foal
lines.note: Feeding (1.0.1): the hungry first wish and the manger wish. Fixed seed because the foal voice runs on eleven_v3.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Make every cup warm, and the egg will hatch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Drag one stone to the nest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: This egg needs two stones. Together they make every cup warm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Look at the stars on the egg. Then drag the stone that matches.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Count the stars on the egg. Then drag the stone that matches.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A big egg! It has two nests of cups.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: A baby unicorn! Hello, little one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your baby needs a name! Tap a bell to hear a name.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Drag the name you like to your baby.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Let's write the name on the tag. Listen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Put the gems in the slots.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Now slide the star, and listen.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: What a great name! It's a tricky one for me to say.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every name needs a pink gem!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's a silly name! Try other gems.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap a picture, and hear the names.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap a gem, and hear names that start with its sound.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap the plus to add a gem slot.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ten stars make a sky unicorn! Give it a name.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: The moon told me a new name!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Read the wish, and feed your baby.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap a food to hear its name. Then give it to a baby.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Give the babies a bedtime snack.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Drag the hay that fills it up.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A cosy tent for now! Your new stable row is coming.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Bedtime! Look at the lantern, and tap that baby's door.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap the moon when it's bedtime.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The sun is going down. Time for bed!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Read the name on the lantern. Then lead that baby to the stable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Lead your babies to the stable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Drag the baby along the glowing path, all the way to the stable.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap a sleepy baby to tuck it in.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Tap the window to see the stars.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: Emma! Your unicorns are moving to a bigger home.

lines.speaker: queen
lines.note: Returning arrival at the meadow (places A7, R54).

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: This meadow is yours. Will you make it a home for my unicorns?

lines.speaker: queen
lines.text: Here is your crown. You are my Nest Keeper now!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.note: Returning arrival goal at the meadow (places A7, R54).
